title: [macOS with Rift window manager] Slow response time when switching focus back to Godot Editor window from another application. hangs for a few seconds before showing Godot.
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in godot 4.5 & 4.6+ (haven't tested in < 4.5)



### System information

macOS tahoe- godot 4.6 stable - all renderers - m5 MacBook Air

### Issue description

[macOS with Rift window manager] Slow response time when switching focus back to Godot Editor window from another application. hangs for a few seconds before showing Godot.  sometimes godot tricks the window manager into thinking there are still windows on screen when there aren't. 

### Steps to reproduce

- open godot in any space, tab to another space, go back to godot space. 
 then you will see the delay before godot editor becomes visible and grabbed focus (about 2 seconds every time)

- play game scene non embedded, it opens in its own window, then exit game from signal, godot editor  thinks something is still taken, and thus reserves an 'empty' space of some other ghost application on the space. my window manager exposes some API to get this, here there are really only 2 things open on the screen, godot editor and my terminal, yet it partitions the screen such that godot takes 1/3rd space, the terminal 1/3rd space, and the remaining 3rd is empty. 

it prints out:
